title: Support Authority Schedule for Wayfare Rides: Review Window, Per-Trip Support Limit and Courtesy Allowance
content:
The figures that bound what rider support may return on trips of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** are set per ride option.

| Figure | Wayfare Shared | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Review window after the charge date (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Support limit per trip (total adjusted or refunded) | $10.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $40.00 | $50.00 |
| Booking fee stays charged on a route-inefficiency or wrong drop-off reduction | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Courtesy refunds per rider in the courtesy window | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Courtesy window (calendar days, current day included) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

## Definitions

- **Review window**: calendar days after the charge date of a charge during which the rider may ask for it to be adjusted or refunded.
- **Support limit per trip**: largest total amount support may adjust or refund on one trip without the fare review team, USD.
- **Booking fee stays charged**: whether the booking fee stays charged when a fare is reduced for route inefficiency or a wrong drop-off (true/false).
- **Courtesy refunds per rider**: most courtesy refunds of a cancellation or no-show fee per rider in the courtesy lookback window, count.
- **Courtesy window**: length of the rolling courtesy lookback window, calendar days including the current day.

## Notes

- The support limit rises with the ride option, from $10.00 on Wayfare Shared to $50.00 on Wayfare Black SUV; Wayfare Standard and Wayfare Green share $15.00, Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL share $25.00, and Wayfare Black is $40.00.
- The review window (30 days), the courtesy allowance (1) and the courtesy window (90 days) are the same on every ride option.
